landed: Each processor owns its prev/cur records, sequence, entry line and coverage. Publish receives that processor and the attempt-local parent. Reentry, a missing slot, an owner mismatch and sequence exhaustion clear coverage and leave the collector running. A shared object is attached only when the parent already created it and magic, nonce, ready, record size and slot count match. The child does not create, truncate or unlink it.

localObject.observedOrder: payload stores, stlr of the 64-bit footer, dmb ish, then ldr of the original cell; the same shape again before the header ldr, with the loaded cell word in the second payload

notLanded: No supervisor-created object was mapped by a built gsi. Dual-worker, partial-commit, cell-fault and header-fault controls were not run. Original TFIB was not run. Request ID and regenerated SMP C remain absent.
